output.action: Agrees to come to the potluck and says he'll bring a bag of ice.
output.explanation: With Mom pressing for an answer and no real conflict, Tyler half-wants to show up after three weeks away. The Thanksgiving memory of showing up with only shredded cheese after forgetting his casserole, plus his admiration for his dad reliably bringing a full dish, nudges him to commit—but he picks the lowest-effort option, a bag of ice, which aligns with his habit of making easy promises he may or may not follow through on.
